headline: St Fagans Food Festival · Story Time & Craft · Circus skills
summary: Today: Story Time and Craft (Llandaff); No Fit State Circus skills · Fri: Stay and Play; Play Time; TQ Toddler Day · Weekend: St Fagans Food Festival; Brick Festival; Penylan LEGO; Canopi trade day; Goodsheds Wild West play

notices.title: Techniquest closed today (Thu)
notices.detail: Closed for maintenance Thu 10 Sep. Reopens Fri 11 Sep for Toddler Day (09:00–16:00), then Sat–Sun normal hours. Relaxed Session Sun 13 Sep 10:00–12:00.

notices.title: Museum of Cardiff — still closed
notices.detail: Museum of Cardiff (Old Library / The Hayes) remains closed due to a leak; organisers will update when they know more.

notices.title: National Museum Cardiff — open today
notices.detail: Open Tue–Sun 10:00–17:00 · closed Mondays. Free entry; book a free day ticket if you can.

datedPicks.title: Techniquest Toddler Day
datedPicks.location: Techniquest, Stuart Street, Cardiff Bay CF10 5BW
datedPicks.cost: Under-3s free · adult from £15.45 · book ahead
datedPicks.description: Pre-schoolers get exclusive run of the exhibits plus Toddler Day extras. Sep extras: Star Stories Oi Frog! (£2 add-on) and Mini Wildlings by Flossy and Boo (included, book ahead).

datedPicks.title: St Fagans Food Festival
datedPicks.location: St Fagans National Museum of History, Cardiff CF5 6XB
datedPicks.cost: Free entry · parking £7/day · some activities paid
datedPicks.description: Annual free festival with 80+ food, drink and craft stalls among the historic buildings, cookery demos, live music and family activities including circus skills. Also Sunday 13 Sep.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Free, distinctive, locally rooted weekend festival with explicit family activities — standout look-ahead.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Organiser: 10am–6pm both days. Busy 10:00–14:00; later afternoon quieter. No advance ticket for entry.

datedPicks.title: Trading cards & retro games at Canopi
datedPicks.location: The Canopi, 59–61 Tudor Street, Cardiff CF11 6AD
datedPicks.cost: Confirm entry on the day · buying/trading cards optional
datedPicks.ageSuitability: DoNext fit: card and gaming fans aged 8–12 with an adult; no organiser age limit stated.
datedPicks.description: A local collectors’ afternoon with a trading room, space for trading-card games and vintage consoles. Free entry makes it easy to have a look before committing to anything.
datedPicks.appeal: Take your card-game fan somewhere they can meet other enthusiasts and explore older consoles.
datedPicks.parentTip: Stay with your child and agree a swap or spending limit before they bring their cards.
datedPicks.bookingStatus: no booking link listed · confirm entry
datedPicks.whyPicked: Local Riverside collectors’ afternoon — indie indoor option beside the Food Festival.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Organiser lists Sat 12 Sep 12:00–16:00 at The Canopi. Entry fee not stated on page this check.

datedPicks.title: Cardiff Brick Festival
datedPicks.location: National Indoor Athletics Centre, Cyncoed Campus, 9 Cyncoed Rd, Cardiff CF23 6XD
datedPicks.cost: Adult £8 · child 5–12 £6 · family £20 · under-5 free with paying adult · Early Bird £13
datedPicks.description: LEGO fan day: large displays, building area, speed builds, traders with loose bricks and sets. Book ahead — regularly sells out.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Clear family LEGO day with official ticket path — strong paid indoor option beside the free Food Festival.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Under-5s free with paying adult (no ticket). Book on organiser site — regularly sells out.

datedPicks.title: Free LEGO hour at Penylan Library
datedPicks.location: Penylan Library and Community Centre, Penylan Road, Cardiff CF23 5HW
datedPicks.ageSuitability: Ages 2+ (organiser). DoNext fit: best for younger builders with an adult.
datedPicks.description: An hour to build something of your own at the local library’s weekly LEGO club.
datedPicks.appeal: A simple free building session when a big ticketed day feels like too much.
datedPicks.parentTip: The library lists this weekly. Confirm it’s running before making a special trip.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Free weekly library LEGO hour — simple local alternative to the ticketed Brick Festival.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Ages 2+. Weekly Saturday 10:00–11:00 at Penylan Library.

datedPicks.title: Wild West play party at Goodsheds
datedPicks.cost: £17 per child advertised · tickets from £18.70 · extra adults £2
datedPicks.ageSuitability: DoNext fit: preschool and early primary. Organiser welcomes all ages; an adult must stay.
datedPicks.description: Songs, dancing, bubbles and parachute play, finishing with cowboy-boot decorating and a character photo opportunity.
datedPicks.appeal: A lively morning for younger children who enjoy pretending, moving and making.
datedPicks.parentTip: Book ahead. Allow £18.70 for the child-and-adult ticket, above the £17 advertised headline.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Barry indie play party with clear booking path — covers Vale/Barry gap.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Book ahead. Headline £17; checkout showed from £18.70. Adult must stay.

datedPicks.title: St Fagans Food Festival (Sunday)
datedPicks.location: St Fagans National Museum of History, Cardiff CF5 6XB
datedPicks.cost: Free entry · parking £7/day · some activities paid
datedPicks.description: Second day of the free St Fagans Food Festival — stalls, demos, music and family activities across the museum site.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Same free festival on Sunday — keeps the weekend window honest.
